$comment: Handoff record for the next team or agent picking up this repository. Update the `updated` field and the relevant sections whenever the project changes materially.

project.name: SIGNAL
project.description: The interactive, gamified portfolio and resume of Jay W. Snyder. A hand-written Three.js game engine where six sectors of a neon corridor each hold one chapter of the resume, unlocked by collecting data shards. Ships with an equivalent written brief for accessibility, SEO and visitors in a hurry.
project.audience: Business owners and operators evaluating whether to hire Jay to build AI systems for them. Secondary: recruiters and engineering leads.
project.goal: Convert. The site is the proof that Jay builds ambitious interactive software; the written brief is the escape hatch for anyone who just wants the facts.

owner.name: Jay W. Snyder
currentRoles: Director of Sales, Marketing & Technology, SkyRun Daytona Vacation Rentals

status.phase: merged to main, awaiting production deploy verification

config.note: vercel.json intentionally makes the build explicit rather than relying on Vercel's framework auto-detection, because this project's Vercel dashboard settings were configured for the previous React/CRA-era app and may not match. Dashboard settings are overridden by vercel.json.

githubPages.note: Still serving the OLD pre-rebuild portfolio from the gh-pages branch. `npm run deploy` republishes it from the current build. Decide whether GitHub Pages should stay live at all, or redirect to the Vercel domain.

stack.rendering: Three.js r180, hand-written engine (no React, no react-three-fiber)
stack.styling: Plain CSS with custom-property design tokens (no Tailwind)

bundleSize.note: Three is deliberately split into its own chunk via rollupOptions.manualChunks so app changes do not invalidate it.

commands.note: There is no test suite. `npm run build` runs `tsc --noEmit` first, so a type error fails the build. Verification during the rebuild was done with Playwright driving the production preview; those scripts were scratch files and were not committed.

architecture.loop: Fixed-step simulation at 60 Hz with an accumulator and a 5-step cap, decoupled from rendering. Frame rate never changes flight feel.

directories.src/core: Engine (renderer, post chain, adaptive quality tiers), Input, Audio, Events bus, Save, Math helpers
directories.src/shaders: Film grain / vignette / chromatic aberration post pass
directories.src/world: World orchestration, Sector, Landmark geometry, Corridor (gates + debris), Grid, Starfield, Label sprites
directories.src/player: Arcade flight model and spring chase camera
directories.src/ui: HUD, Codex dossier, Terminal, Toasts, Boot, TopBar, Brief, Complete
directories.src/data: ALL CONTENT. Nothing user-visible is hard-coded elsewhere.

notableTechniques: Adaptive quality governor: sustained frame-time drops step pixel ratio, bloom, grain and star count down a tier instead of stuttering.
Procedural WebAudio for the drone, collection chimes and decrypt fanfare. Zero audio files ship.
Derivative-antialiased infinite grid shader; GPU point-cloud starfield with a seeded PRNG so the sky is identical every visit.
Corridor gates fade by view depth via an onBeforeCompile shader injection, so a gate sweeping past the camera never blows out to a white bar.
Shard magnetism: shards break orbit and chase the ship inside 30 units, so collecting is 'fly roughly there' rather than a precision test.
Landmarks are offset to the side of the flight line, because the corridor spline runs through each sector centre.
architecture.debugging: `window.SIGNAL.debug()` in the browser console returns ship position, yaw, speed, progress and per-sector shard distances.

content.note: src/data feeds BOTH the 3D dossiers and the written brief. Editing one updates both; they cannot drift.

files.src/data/profile.ts: Name, contact, tagline, pitch paragraphs, values, headline stats
files.src/data/content.ts: Ventures, projects, career timeline, education, services, skill groups
files.src/data/sectors.ts: How that content is laid out across the six sectors: position, colour, shard count, blocks, locked bonus block

content.howToAddAProject: Add an entry to `projects` in src/data/content.ts, then reference its id from a sector's `cards` block in src/data/sectors.ts. The written brief picks it up automatically.

sectors.name: VENTURES
sectors.covers: Dazzle Divas Cleaning, SkyRun Daytona, Hacktivate Nation

accessibility.briefMode: Every word in the 3D world also exists as a semantic, keyboard-navigable HTML document. Toggle with the toolbar button, the `B` key, the terminal `brief` command, or the skip link.
automaticFallbacks: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> brief mode on first visit
No WebGL support -> brief mode, with an explanatory note
Any exception during engine start -> brief mode
accessibility.skipLink: First tab stop on the page, jumps to the brief and switches modes.
accessibility.liveRegion: Achievement toasts are mirrored into a polite aria-live region.
accessibility.note: The brief lives in normal document flow as a direct child of <body>, NOT inside the fixed #ui overlay. Moving it back inside #ui breaks document scrolling and in-page anchors.

seo.canonicalUrlNote: index.html currently points canonical, og:url and og:image at the GitHub Pages URL. If Vercel is the primary host, update all three to the Vercel domain. Social scrapers require absolute URLs.

designDecisions.decision: Dual mode: playable world plus written brief
designDecisions.why: A client evaluating Jay at 11pm may not want to fly a spaceship. The brief protects the conversion goal and covers accessibility, SEO and low-power devices.
Matches where Jay's recent work actually is (KnotzHardDrivin and KnotzGalaga2 are both raw three + Vite + TypeScript) and shows engine-level capability that React would hide.

designDecisions.decision: Direct, slightly confrontational copy ('Most people selling you AI have never had to make payroll. I have.')
designDecisions.why: Owning two operating businesses while writing the software is Jay's real differentiator. Easy to soften in src/data/profile.ts if it ever needs to.

designDecisions.decision: A dossier stays open until dismissed, not until the ship drifts out of the sector
designDecisions.why: Auto-closing snatched content away mid-sentence. The ship also drops to 42% cruise speed while a dossier is open.

bugsFixedDuringRebuild: The #ui overlay won on CSS specificity and swallowed all pointer events, which silently killed drag-to-fly on touch devices.
The written brief lived inside a fixed full-viewport overlay, so the page could not scroll and in-page anchors went nowhere.
Dossiers closed themselves a few seconds after arrival as the ship drifted out of the sector radius.
The ORIGIN torus knot rendered as an invisible dark silhouette: a smooth knot has no hard edges, so EdgesGeometry produced nothing to draw.

openItems.item: Record the production Vercel URL in this file and confirm the deploy actually ran against commit a0ad14e.
Once the production host is settled, update canonical / og:url / og:image in index.html and `seo.canonicalUrl` here.
GitHub Pages still serves the old portfolio. Either run `npm run deploy` to refresh it, or take it down / redirect it to the primary host.
src/data/profile.ts contains a GUESSED LinkedIn URL. Verify or replace it before the site is promoted.
Dazzle Divas start year (2018) was inferred from the company website's 'licensed and insured since 2018'. The SkyRun role has no start date, only 'Present'. Confirm both in src/data/content.ts.
No automated tests. Playwright covers the other Knotz repos well; a smoke suite (boot, launch, warp, brief toggle, shard pickup) would protect the engine from regressions.
public/og.jpg was rendered with fallback system fonts because Google Fonts was unreachable in the build environment. Re-rendering it with Space Grotesk loaded would tighten the typography.

knownRisks: Vercel's dashboard settings for this project predate the rebuild. vercel.json overrides build command, output directory and framework, but an 'Ignored Build Step' rule or a production branch other than `main` would still block the deploy and cannot be seen from the repository.
Fonts load from Google Fonts. If they fail, the design falls back to system stacks and still reads correctly, but tracking and weights shift.
Progress is stored in localStorage under the key `signal.save.v2`. Bumping the shape means bumping the version and the `v` check in src/core/Save.ts, or returning visitors get a blank run.

conventions.branching: Feature work on `claude/<topic>` branches, merged to `main` with --no-ff.
conventions.commits: Imperative subject under ~72 chars, body explaining why. Co-Authored-By trailer for agent-assisted work.
conventions.codeStyle: Match the surrounding file. Comments explain why, not what. Strict TypeScript; the build fails on unused locals and parameters.
